content.text:
Your local `.venv` already has Playwright and Chromium installed. Use it instead of Homebrew’s protected global Python:

```zsh
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m secman_visual_check --no-ai https://example.com
```

Or without activating:

```zsh
.venv/bin/python -m secman_visual_check --no-ai https://example.com
```

I also updated the CLI error message to recommend the venv path, with a regression test in [capture.py](/Users/flake/sources/misc/secman/extensions/secman_visual_check/secman_visual_check/capture.py:178) and [test_capture.py](/Users/flake/sources/misc/secman/extensions/secman_visual_check/tests/test_capture.py:123).
